regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin — A coated carrier delivers doxorubicin, which damages DNA. Prior anthracycline exposure matters for heart safety. Trabectedin — It binds to DNA and disrupts processes that tumour cells need to grow.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: You receive a steroid before pegylated liposomal doxorubicin, followed by trabectedin over three hours. Your team normally recommends a central line. Treatment repeats every 21 days while it helps and remains tolerable.
key_points: Two infusions on day 1 every three weeks.
Call your oncology unit urgently for fever, shivering or sudden illness. Call urgently for severe muscle pain, weakness or dark urine.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Adjuvant treatment after surgery for high-risk stage I–III endometrial carcinoma.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Cisplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. It can also affect kidney function, hearing and nerves. Paclitaxel — It disrupts cell division. Hair follicles, blood cells and nerves can also be affected. Carboplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. Kidney function helps determine the prescribed amount.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Usually start 4–6 weeks after surgery. Cisplatin is given before radiation on two treatment days three weeks apart. Ring both teams if radiation is cancelled. Cisplatin is only given on a radiation day. Within three weeks of finishing radiation, start paclitaxel then carboplatin AUC 5, every three weeks for four cycles. Bring your steroid premedication instructions.
key_points: Two cisplatin visits during radiotherapy, then four chemotherapy cycles.
Call your oncology unit urgently for fever, shivering or sudden illness. Report persistent vomiting, reduced urine or severe diarrhoea promptly.
regimen_profiles.review_status: Feasibility build. Clinical, pharmacy and patient review pending.

regimen_profiles.regimen_role: Ovarian dysgerminoma and other germ-cell tumours
regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Includes advanced or metastatic ovarian dysgerminoma (00300c). Testicular and extragonadal indications have separate NCCP codes under the same protocol.
regimen_profiles.treatment_setting: Ovarian dysgerminoma and other germ-cell tumours
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Bleomycin — It causes DNA strand breaks. Lung injury can develop during or after treatment. Etoposide — It prevents dividing cells from rejoining DNA. Low blood counts and hair loss can follow. Cisplatin — It damages DNA in dividing cells. It can also affect kidney function, hearing and nerves.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin are given on day 1. IV fluids and an anti-sickness plan cover the five-day cisplatin block. Return on each of days 2, 3, 4 and 5 for etoposide, cisplatin and fluids. Keep using the same dated anti-sickness prescription for this block. Bleomycin alone on days 8 and 15. The cycle repeats every 21 days. The consultant confirms your total number of cycles based on diagnosis and risk.
key_points: Five consecutive infusion days, then bleomycin on days 8 and 15.
Call your oncology unit urgently for fever, shivering or sudden illness. Report new dry cough or breathlessness immediately, even after the last dose.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: Low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (FIGO score 6 or less).
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Methotrexate — It blocks the supply of folate that rapidly growing trophoblastic cells need. Folinic acid — It provides usable folate to healthy cells after methotrexate. The 24-hour interval matters.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Methotrexate 50 mg is given into a muscle on days 1, 3, 5 and 7. Write down the actual time of each injection. A new cycle starts every 14 days. Take folinic acid 15 mg by mouth exactly 24 hours after each injection. Contact the unit immediately if a tablet is late, missed or vomited. Ask the team what to do before taking another dose.
key_points: Four injections on alternate days, each followed 24 hours later by a rescue tablet.
Call your oncology unit urgently for fever, shivering or sudden illness. Call immediately if a rescue tablet is missed, vomited or late.

treatment_rationale.summary: Low-dose methotrexate and folinic acid achieved remission for many patients. A rising or plateauing hCG led to reassessment and treatment changes.
treatment_rationale.limitations: This specialist-centre cohort was observational. Ongoing hCG testing is essential even after a response.

evidence_records.evidence_context: Ovarian, fallopian tube or primary peritoneal cancer
key_findings: Clinical benefit in evaluable patients was 36/76 (47%) on weekly topotecan and 46/80 (58%) on the five-day regimen, p=0.205. Blood toxicity was lower with weekly administration.
evidence_records.limitations: The study enrolled platinum-resistant disease. Choice of schedule also depends on prior treatment and the activity required.

key_findings: In the platinum-sensitive subgroup, median progression-free survival was 9.2 months with the combination versus 7.5 months with PLD alone (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.56–0.95).
evidence_records.limitations: The trial does not compare this combination directly with retreatment using platinum.
